title: Fix and verify GAWD, GEMI, and GMCP pillar runtime, CLI, and parity contracts
goal: Fix root causes found during live E2E verification across Susi Core's three pillars (GAWD, GEMI, GMCP): fail closed on empty GMCP resources/read URIs and malformed prompts/get payloads, replace hardcoded root-only workspace paths in context_graph/agent_tx/broker/harness with workspace-confined and shared-helper contracts, ship pure-Rust susi harness scorecard without Python subprocess dependency, update socket parity coverage, and keep first-party runtime and test line counts within lean_core_ceilings.

reuse.reason: Reuses git_governor::{run_git,cat_file_batch_json} and lifecycle::DEFAULT_LIFECYCLE_PATH for pure-Rust scorecard, confined_with_rel and grants_for helpers in susi-core, workflow_runner::git_raw helper, and moves unchanged harness inline test suites to src/tests/ per crate convention.
